assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints remain unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All spatial actions are conceptual recommendations and require professional confirmation before statutory or engineering use.

assumptions.statement: The repository boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Areas and ratios are reproducible from this package but must be recalculated after official polygons are issued.

assumptions.statement: International references contribute transferable mechanisms only; their governance, metrics, and legal effects are not transferred.
assumptions.impact: Each mechanism requires Beijing-specific legal, operational, and community review.

assumptions.statement: Every proposed AI service must preserve a non-AI route, named human owner, stop trigger, and minimal-data rule.
assumptions.impact: No scenario is approved for deployment by this submission.
